instruction: You are the shop floor controller for Northstar Controls. Resolve FACTORYBENCH-012 (Return unused copper from a canceled operation). Confirm the cancellation and physical count, then return the excess from WIP to the original controlled subinventory. The case is an isolated snapshot as of 2026-01-12; correlate immutable IDs and effective revisions rather than matching names alone. Evidence is distributed across Oracle Fusion, Gmail, Drive, Sheets, and Slack, with inspectable files including `operating-policy.md`, `contract-or-service-control.md`, `supplier-quotation.pdf`, `supplier-lead-time-and-capacity.xlsx`, `approval-decision-log.csv`, `source-email-thread.eml`, `operations-slack-thread.json`, `drive-approval-record.json`. After the documented Oracle operation, write the outcome into the existing control-workbook cell; then send the scoped completion email. Return exactly: transaction_reference, item_lot, posted_quantity.

Communicate the resulting identifier and effective date; never infer approval from silence.
